Plants terrestrial, 25-60 cm tall, with a leafy stem and fibrous roots; pseudobulbs absent. Leaves 3-5, elliptic to ovate-lanceolate, plicate, 6-18 cm long. Flower usually solitary, resupinate, fragrant. Sepals and petals maroon-purple, the petals twisted, 3-5 cm long. Labellum inflated, pouch-shaped (saccate), bright yellow, 20-35 mm long, with an inrolled margin. Floral spur absent. Column short, bearing a conspicuous petaloid staminode; pollinia 4, granular, without caudicles. Flowering May to July.
